findings.search_flag_not_forwarded_to_exec: Measured on both 0.155.1 and 0.157.1: `codex --search exec ...` sends settings.external_web_access false to the search endpoint, the same as no flag, while `codex exec -c web_search="live" ...` sends true. Source: the Exec branch of codex-rs/cli/src/main.rs forwards only the shared root options and -c overrides, and core config defaults the mode to cached (stage/source-checks.txt). The sweep's GPT-6 lanes therefore searched in cached mode; add -c web_search="live" to codex_argv if live search is intended. Measured with a fake provider marked supports_standalone_web_search; the OpenAI provider uses the same extension and mode resolution (source reading, not a live-provider measurement).
findings.exec_json_web_search_items: 0.157.1 reports an open of a literal URL as action type open_page and attaches `results`; 0.155.1 reported the same call as `other` without results. The lane rollout of gpt6-discover-workers (0.155.1) holds 32 openPage and 6 search web actions, which its exec --json stream reported as other and search. Consumers that count web_search actions see different types after the switch; codex_job.py ignores item.* content and is unaffected.
findings.state_migration: 0.157.1 applies two new state_5.sqlite migrations (55 -> 57) and one thread_history_1.sqlite migration (6 -> 7) on first use; ~/.codex is at 55 and 6 now. In a scratch CODEX_HOME, 0.155.1 still completed an exec turn after 0.157.1 had migrated it (M3); the migrations stay applied.
findings.background_server: Measured in the sandbox (results/daemon.json): a plain interactive 0.157.1 launch printed `Installing daemon from CLI version 0.157.1 into <home>/packages/app-server-daemon`, copied the 391,126,382-byte package there, and started `app-server --listen unix:// --managed-daemon` and `app-server daemon pid-update-loop` from that copy; both outlived the TUI. A plain 0.155.1 launch on the same home connected to that server: the process at the other end of the connection the server accepted runs the 0.155.1 binary. `codex app-server daemon stop` (0.157.1) stopped the server and left the updater loop running; SIGTERM ended it. `--no-daemon`, and `codex features disable daemon_auto_start` (which appended daemon_auto_start = false to the existing [features] table), each prevented the copy and both processes; 0.155.1 read that config.toml, applied its other settings in an exec turn and started its TUI. Source only, not measured (the sandbox had no network and each server lived under a minute): the updater is on by default and, five minutes after start and then every 60 minutes, fetches https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh and runs it to install the latest release into the daemon's package copy (stage/daemon-source-checks.txt). A server started on this host would therefore run outside the integrity-checked prefix and move to later releases without a pin change. `codex exec`, which the sweep lanes use, has no background-server code at either tag, and none of the 21 scratch homes of the first qualification (14 of them with exec-turn state) holds a packages directory.

switch_commands_for_the_coordinator: # 1. After the sweep: confirm no Codex 0.155.1 process runs (the bracketed pattern cannot match its own grep):
grep -l 'codex-0[.]155[.]1/' /proc/[0-9]*/cmdline 2>/dev/null; ls -l /proc/[0-9]*/exe 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'tools/codex-0[.]155[.]1/'   # expect no file names and 0

# 2. Before any interactive 0.157.1 launch, turn off the background server's automatic start in ~/.codex/config.toml with the staged binary; a plain `codex` launch (for example the pending /hooks trust step) otherwise starts a self-updating server from a package copy under ~/.codex (results/daemon.json T1, T7):
~/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/codex-0.157.1/bin/codex features disable daemon_auto_start   # Disabled feature `daemon_auto_start` in config.toml.
~/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/codex-0.157.1/bin/codex features list | grep '^daemon_auto_start '   # daemon_auto_start  stable  false
# 4. One live probe from an empty directory outside every repository (exec never starts the server; this first 0.157.1 run migrates ~/.codex state_5 55->57, thread_history_1 6->7):
codex exec --ignore-user-config --skip-git-repo-check -s read-only -m gpt-6-astra -c model_reasoning_effort="max" --json 'Reply with the word PROBE-OK.' < /dev/null
# 5. No background server and no package copy; run these again after the first interactive launch:
test -e "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/packages/app-server-daemon" && echo present || echo absent   # absent
rollback_commands: # 1. A server left running would keep serving 0.155.1's TUI after the relink (T3), and `daemon stop` leaves its updater loop running (T4); when the check prints more than 0, stop both and check again (T5):
ls -l /proc/[0-9]*/exe 2>/dev/null | grep -cF "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/packages/app-server-daemon/"   # 0 when switch step 2 ran first
~/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/codex-0.157.1/bin/codex app-server daemon stop   # {"status":"stopped",...}, or {"status":"notRunning",...} when none runs (T6)

for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do case "$(readlink "$p/exe" 2>/dev/null)" in "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"/packages/app-server-daemon/*) echo "TERM ${p#/proc/} $(readlink "$p/exe")"; kill -TERM "${p#/proc/}";; esac; done
# 2. Switch the link back and record it:

# The ~/.codex migrations stay applied (0.155.1 ran an exec turn on a migrated scratch home, M3). The daemon_auto_start = false line can stay: 0.155.1 read that config.toml in an exec turn (T8) and its TUI started with it (T9). A ~/.codex/packages/app-server-daemon copy is inert once no process runs from it; 0.155.1 manages only packages/standalone (stage/daemon-source-checks.txt).
